title: Deployment, Activation and Order Cancellation — Sentinel Managed Security
content:
Deployment of a Sentinel Managed Security subscription begins once the order is signed; the subscription then moves from ordered to deploying.

## Activation

Monitoring is activated when at least the tier's activation threshold percentage of the contracted endpoints report healthy agents. On activation the subscription moves from deploying to active, monitoring goes live and the term starts.

- The term starts on the activation date and ends on the day before the same day of the month the term's number of calendar months later.
- The tier's deployment target in business days is a planning target, not a guarantee.
- Activation grants the first contract year's annual included incident response hours.

### Threshold boundary (hypothetical endpoint counts and threshold)

With 60 contracted endpoints and a threshold of 90 percent, 54 healthy agents are needed: 54 reporting healthy meets the threshold and 53 does not. With 45 contracted endpoints and the same threshold, 90 percent of 45 is 40.5, so at least 41 healthy agents are needed, since 40 falls short of 40.5.

### Term dates (hypothetical activation date)

| Activation date | Term ordered | Term start | Term end |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 1 month | 10 March | 9 April |
| 10 March | 12 months | 10 March | 9 March of the following year |
| 10 March | 36 months | 10 March | 9 March three years later |

## Cancellation of an order

An order may be cancelled by the client only before deployment begins; the onboarding fee is then reversed and no other charge applies. A cancelled order moves from ordered to cancelled, and the date of cancellation is recorded as its closing date.

| Status when the client asks to cancel | May the client cancel the order? | Charges |
|---|---|---|
| Ordered (deployment not begun) | Yes | Onboarding fee reversed; no other charge |
| Deploying, or any status reached after deployment began | No | Not applicable |
